admission.official_test_scope: Narrow synthetic metadata fixture, two usage-schema branches; real Core MCP child and reviewed CLI pair; no model inference, subscription authentication or general-task quality measurement.
admission.pair_provenance: Existing private reviewed copies, SHA rechecked by production admission path. No download/install/authentication performed; upstream archive/source pins remain in managed-codex-worker-boundary.md.

composition.new_hardening: Full artifact handlers preserve Core/primary receipt checks before recovery, after recovery, and at registered result delivery; private exact-owner worker projection remains Store-less and protected-only.
composition.native_gate_order: Explicit legacy executor and native retained checkpoint/FIFO inspection deny before retiring prior closed receipt.
composition.preserved: Scoped quota/provider catalogs and checks before discovery/effects; strict per-call Memory snapshot transport; sealed recovery grants/generation; pure receipt checks under existing session lock and nonblocking/nofollow checkpoint reads; NoReplay/NoAutomaticFailover; one Core authority.
